# Open Computing Facility at UC Berkeley

> OCF is a student-run organization providing free computing services to the UC Berkeley community, including lab access, web hosting, email, HPC resources, and shell accounts.

The Open Computing Facility operates as a volunteer-driven student organization at UC Berkeley, offering essential computing infrastructure and support services. OCF maintains diverse resources including physical computer labs, virtual hosting platforms, high-performance computing capabilities, and software mirrors, all managed through open-source technologies like Linux and Kubernetes.

## Getting Started

- [Open Computing Facility at UC Berkeley](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu): OCF homepage: student-run free computing services at UC Berkeley
- [Services](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/docs/services): Overview of OCF services: lab access, hosting, HPC, email
- [Computer Lab](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/docs/services/lab): OCF computer lab details: hours, location, workstations, software
- [Lab Statistics](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/stats): Real-time lab statistics: desktop utilization, printer status

## Account & Access

- [OCF Login](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/account/vhost/mail): OCF user login portal for account and service access
- [CAS - CalNet Authentication Service Login](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/account/password): CalNet authentication and password reset portal for OCF
- [Staff Hours](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/staff-hours): OCF staff office hours and drop-in support schedule

## Service Status & Announcements

- [Open Computing Facility Status](https://status.ocf.berkeley.edu): OCF service status page: incidents, outages, maintenance
- [News from the Staff Team](https://www.ocf.berkeley.edu/announcements): OCF announcements, service status updates, and staff news
- [Planned Outage: All OCF Services, August 14](https://status.ocf.berkeley.edu/2024/08/planned-outage-all-ocf-services-august.html): Outage notice for all OCF services on August 14
- [Planned Outage: OCF Mirrors, Aug. 11](https://status.ocf.berkeley.edu/2024/08/planned-outage-ocf-mirrors.html): Outage notice for OCF Mirrors maintenance on August 11
